purpose: Forensic discrepancy register and remediation mapping for independent review findings of CTO Directive 107.
governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 (Non-Self-Acceptance)

discrepancies.priorReportValue: TEST_HARNESS_PROTECTION_TOKEN was exported and constructed via Symbol.for('KSHETRA_TEST_ONLY_HARNESS_PROTECTION_TOKEN'), and four __testOnly_* functions were exported directly from the production verifier module.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Removed TEST_HARNESS_PROTECTION_TOKEN and all __testOnly_* functions from the production verifier's public interface. Public verifiers (verifyHistoricalArtifactIntegrity, verifyAuthorityBoundary, verifyGoverningSpecificationProvenance, reconcileExecutionLedger) unconditionally reject all 10 FORBIDDEN_TRUST_OVERRIDES. Test injection is structurally isolated in tests/helpers/ledger-test-adapter.mjs without relying on caller-reproducible tokens or global symbols.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Misconception that Symbol.for(...) created a private unforgeable capability, when in JavaScript Symbol.for accesses the global runtime symbol registry and can be reproduced by any caller using the same string key.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 107 introduced Symbol.for token to separate test injection from production mode flags, which was identified as a forgeable trust token during independent review.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Extracted shared verification engine into scripts/internal/reconcile_engine.mjs. Exported strictly safe-by-default public entry points from scripts/reconcile_execution_ledger.mjs that unconditionally throw CALLER_TRUST_OVERRIDE_PROHIBITED on any forbidden override. Created isolated test seam in tests/helpers/ledger-test-adapter.mjs exercising the shared engine for controlled adversarial fixtures.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Adversarial manifest validation tests only checked lexical path traversal (../../../../etc/passwd) and did not include a genuine test fixture proving rejection of symlinks/junctions resolving outside the repository root.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Enforced canonical containment in assertPathContainedInRoot and validateManifestIntegrity using fs.realpathSync to dereference filesystem symlinks/junctions and verify containment within realRepoRoot + path.sep. Authored genuine symlink-escape adversarial fixture in Suite 28 and Suite 29 proving fail-closed rejection.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Lexical path validation (path.resolve) without verifying canonical filesystem resolution (fs.realpathSync) in adversarial test suites.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 107 added lexical path traversal checks and basic path separator checks, but did not construct a physical symlink adversarial fixture.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Hardened assertPathContainedInRoot and validateManifestIntegrity to perform realpath canonicalization against realRepoRoot + path.sep. Added genuine symlink/junction adversarial test fixtures in tests/political-intelligence-directive-107.test.mjs and tests/political-intelligence-directive-108.test.mjs asserting rejection with 'resolves through symlink outside repository root'.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: reports/w021_5_directive_106_discrepancy_register.json recorded generatedAt as 2026-10-19T13:40:00.000Z while the test execution manifest recorded 2026-10-19T08:38:45.846Z.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Reconciled generatedAt in reports/w021_5_directive_106_discrepancy_register.json to authentic UTC 2026-10-19T08:38:45.846Z matching the Directive 107 delivery epoch.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Local Indian Standard Time (13:40 IST = 08:10 UTC) was manually formatted with a trailing 'Z' indicating UTC rather than generating true UTC via new Date().toISOString().
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Manual timestamp assignment in discrepancy register during Directive 107 delivery.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Audited and corrected generatedAt in reports/w021_5_directive_106_discrepancy_register.json to true UTC, and ensured all Directive 108 evidence artifacts use programmatic UTC ISO strings.

discrepancies.priorReportValue: Directive 107 tests 1.1 through 1.4 only tested a subset of 3 to 5 override keys per verifier while claiming general trust override rejection.
discrepancies.canonicalCommittedValue: Exhaustive 4x10 matrix testing all 10 FORBIDDEN_TRUST_OVERRIDES against each of the 4 public verifier entry points (40 discrete checks), verifying fail-closed rejection with CALLER_TRUST_OVERRIDE_PROHIBITED and exact key identification.
discrepancies.representationOrigin: Sampling override parameters in test assertions rather than testing the complete enumeration.
discrepancies.historicalLineage: Directive 107 introduced FORBIDDEN_TRUST_OVERRIDES with 10 keys but only tested subsets in individual test cases.
discrepancies.resolutionAction: Refactored tests 1.1-1.4 in tests/political-intelligence-directive-107.test.mjs and implemented comprehensive 40-check matrix in tests/political-intelligence-directive-108.test.mjs.
